audio.text: Didn't the deadline for the scholarship get extended?

options: Only for students who applied last year.
Yes, the scholarship is very generous.
I'm extending my stay until Sunday.
The deadline was printed in bold.

why.en: A qualified answer (only for some students). C reuses "extend" with another meaning.
why.tr: Kısıtlı bir yanıt (yalnızca bazı öğrenciler için). C "extend" kelimesini başka anlamda kullanıyor.
